subject.title: [OAuth] Client ID revoked `app_EMoamEEZ73f0CkXaXp7hrann` - fresh ChatGPT Plus logins completely broken

question: Should OpenClaw rotate or override the bundled OpenAI ChatGPT OAuth client ID, or keep the current upstream Codex client ID and focus on live proof plus scope alignment first?
rationale: OAuth app registration, upstream client ownership, and fresh-account browser validation are outside a safe automated repair, and current upstream Codex still uses the same client ID.

options.title: Validate then align with upstream
options.body: Keep this issue open, collect fresh browser proof, and align scopes/client behavior with upstream Codex before deciding on any rotation.

options.title: Rotate the OAuth client
options.body: Register or obtain a new maintainer-owned OpenAI OAuth app and update browser, device-code, refresh, tests, and docs together after live proof.

options.title: Close after successful live login
options.body: If a maintainer proves the current client ID works for fresh ChatGPT Plus/Pro browser login, close this as not reproducible and route remaining model-access failures to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90536.

recommendation.title: Validate then align with upstream
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, collect fresh browser proof, and align scopes/client behavior with upstream Codex before deciding on any rotation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current OpenAI provider unification and OAuth file ownership trace most directly through PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88451.
